origin.originstweaks.arachnid.name: Arachnid
origin.originstweaks.arachnid.descriptio: Eight-legged hunters of cave and canopy, who spin their silk into roads and snares and climb where others dare not look. Their venom is patient, their bodies are slight, and every cousin of the arthropod kind knows them as kin.
power.originstweaks.master_of_webs.name: Master of Webs
power.originstweaks.master_of_webs.descr: Silk is a road, a snare and a home to you, and cobwebs bend to your will.
badge.originstweaks.master_of_webs.0: Hold [Primary] to shoot a web: grapple to a block within 72 blocks, or reel a creature within 24 blocks toward you. Reeled creatures are Webbed, 35% slower for 3 s.
badge.originstweaks.master_of_webs.1: Holds 7 silk. A shot costs 1, and reeling a creature costs 1 more every 0.75 s. One regrows every 5 s, and sleeping refills it.
badge.originstweaks.master_of_webs.2: Cobwebs do not slow you, and you can climb them while climbing is on.
badge.originstweaks.master_of_webs.3.suf: Sneak to cut a cobweb almost instantly and get back its 9 string. Otherwise webs resist breaking so you do not tear them by accident.
power.originstweaks.venom.name: Venom
power.originstweaks.venom.description: Your bite carries a patient poison that lays low what you cannot outrun.
badge.originstweaks.venom.0: [Secondary] swaps between Climbing and Venom. Venom works only while climbing is off.
badge.originstweaks.venom.1: Venom mode: each melee hit has a 20% chance to inflict Poison II for 5 s that ignores armor and Protection, then a 5 s lull.
power.originstweaks.climbing.name: Climbing
power.originstweaks.climbing.description: Your legs grip any wall as surely as a ladder.
badge.originstweaks.climbing.0: [Secondary] swaps between Climbing and Venom. Climbing is on by default.
badge.originstweaks.climbing.1: No mining speed penalty while clinging to a wall.
badge.originstweaks.climbing.2: While climbing is on, your attack reach grows by 25% and each hit has a 30% chance to slow its target for 2 s, or 60% on a critical hit.
power.originstweaks.arachnid_diet.name: Fresh Kill
power.originstweaks.arachnid_diet.descri: A spider wants its prey fresh. Cooking takes the life out of a meal.
badge.originstweaks.arachnid_diet.0: Raw meat and fish restore 50% more hunger and 100% more saturation.
badge.originstweaks.arachnid_diet.1: Cooked meat, fish and meals restore 25% less hunger and saturation.
power.originstweaks.arachnid_frailty.des: A lean, many-jointed body trades toughness for nimbleness.
power.originstweaks.arthropod.name: Arthropod
power.originstweaks.arthropod.descriptio: Small, light and quick to land on your feet, you are every inch an insect.
badge.originstweaks.arthropod.0: You stand 15% shorter, about 1.5 blocks tall.
badge.originstweaks.arthropod.1: Falls up to 16 blocks deal no damage.
badge.originstweaks.arthropod.2: Weapons with Bane of Arthropods hit you harder.
power.originstweaks.arthropod_kinship.de: Spiders, bees, silverfish and other arthropods see you as one of their own. They leave you be unless you strike them, and rush to your side when you are hurt.
badge.originstweaks.arthropod_kinship.0: Arthropods will not attack you unless you hurt them first.
badge.originstweaks.arthropod_kinship.1: Arthropods within 10 blocks attack whatever damages you.
power.originstweaks.avian_diet.name: Fruit and Seed
power.originstweaks.avian_diet.descripti: Light bodies run on fresh fruit and greens, and take little from heavy baking.
badge.originstweaks.avian_diet.0: Fruit, vegetables and berries restore 25% more hunger and 50% more saturation.
badge.originstweaks.avian_diet.1: Bread, cookies and pies restore 25% less hunger and saturation.
power.originstweaks.avian_peace.name: Beloved
power.originstweaks.avian_peace.descript: Creatures in every realm love you, and their monsters hold their claws. Only phantoms, the old rivals of the sky, still hunt you.
badge.originstweaks.avian_peace.0: Hostile mobs in every dimension ignore you, except phantoms and bosses (over 50 max health), until you attack one. That turns every hostile mob within 24 blocks of it against you.
origin.originstweaks.avian.name: Avian
origin.originstweaks.avian.description: A gentle, hollow-boned people who never lost the gift of flight. Beloved by the creatures of the overworld and tolerated by its monsters, they hold the sky as their own, though the sky is no place for the brittle.
power.originstweaks.slow_falling.name: Featherweight
power.originstweaks.slow_falling.descrip: You fall as gently to the ground as a feather would.
badge.originstweaks.slow_falling.1: While on: a gentle fall with no fall damage, and 15% more speed. It draws on a feather bar for about 22 s aloft, and refills 3 s after you stop using it.
power.originstweaks.bird_bones.name: Hollow Bones
power.originstweaks.bird_bones.descripti: Your bones are hollow like a bird's. They keep you light enough to fly, but leave you brittle.
badge.originstweaks.bird_bones.0: You take 18% more damage from all sources.
power.originstweaks.animal_friendship.de: Wild things feel no fear around you, and their trust comes without bribes.
badge.originstweaks.animal_friendship.0: Press [Primary] on a tameable animal within 3 blocks to tame it at once. 2-minute cooldown.
badge.originstweaks.animal_friendship.1: Tameable animals: wolves, cats, parrots, horses, donkeys, mules and llamas.
badge.originstweaks.animal_friendship.2: Foxes, ocelots and axolotls within 16 blocks trust you, do not flee, and will even fight for you.
power.originstweaks.green_thumb.name: Green Thumb
power.originstweaks.green_thumb.descript: Green things grow plentiful at your touch.
badge.originstweaks.green_thumb.0: Harvesting crops with a hoe drops 1 to 2 extra. Each fairy within 12 blocks gives a third chance of 2 to 3 instead, certain with 3 fairies.
badge.originstweaks.green_thumb.1: Hoe-harvested carrots and melon slices have a 12% chance to drop a golden form (4% more per fairy within 12 blocks, up to 24% with 3), and oak or dark oak leaves broken with a hoe may drop a golden apple.
badge.originstweaks.green_thumb.2: You can eat glistering melon slices.
origin.originstweaks.blazeborn.name: Blazeborn
origin.originstweaks.blazeborn.descripti: Late descendants of the Blaze, born of flame and fed on fuel. They gather fire like breath and spend it to burn, to fly and to hurl embers, but water and cold are their enemies, and the fire is always hungry.
power.originstweaks.blaze_flight.name: Blaze Flight
power.originstweaks.blaze_flight.descrip: Your fire spreads into wings that carry you above the world, burning as you climb.
badge.originstweaks.blaze_flight.0: Double-tap jump to fly while you have Fire Power and more than 3 drumsticks of hunger.
badge.originstweaks.blaze_flight.1: Flying burns 10 Fire Power per second and sets you alight. You fall when it runs out.
badge.originstweaks.blaze_flight.2: Flying through lava refills the bar instead.
badge.originstweaks.blaze_flight.3: Sprinting while flying doubles your speed. Keep it up for 1.5 s and you build smoothly over 2 s to an avian's top surge speed.
power.originstweaks.molten_core.name: Molten Core
power.originstweaks.molten_core.descript: Lava and fire are your forge. You wade through molten rock as though it were open air, and the flames stoke your powers back to readiness.
badge.originstweaks.molten_core.0: Swim through lava at triple speed.
badge.originstweaks.molten_core.1: Fire Power fills twice as fast in lava, and 87.5% faster standing in fire.
power.originstweaks.burning_wrath.name: Burning Wrath
power.originstweaks.burning_wrath.descri: For centuries the Blazeborn have called on fire to aid them in both fight and survival.
badge.originstweaks.burning_wrath.0: [Primary] sets you ablaze for 30 s. Costs 40 Fire Power, and needs more than 3 drumsticks of hunger.
badge.originstweaks.burning_wrath.1: While ablaze: 35% chance to land a critical hit, and hits ignite targets for 6 s, once every 10 s.
badge.originstweaks.burning_wrath.2: While ablaze, use campfires to light them and furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces and brewing stands to fuel them.
power.originstweaks.feed_the_flame.name: Feed the Flame
power.originstweaks.feed_the_flame.descr: No ordinary meal sustains a creature of fire. You subsist by burning fuel, which stokes you richly.
badge.originstweaks.feed_the_flame.0: You can eat coal, charcoal, logs, planks, saplings, sticks, bamboo, mushrooms and fungi, each restoring 8 hunger.
badge.originstweaks.feed_the_flame.1: You cannot eat normal food such as meat or vegetables.
power.originstweaks.drink_lava.name: Drink the Deep
power.originstweaks.drink_lava.descripti: Lava is the richest draught of all.
badge.originstweaks.drink_lava.0: Drinking a lava bucket restores 8 hunger and 12.8 saturation.
power.originstweaks.fiery_metabolism.des: The fire within you burns hot and hungry.
power.originstweaks.firecharged_projecti: Ember and spite gather in your palm, ready to be flung.
badge.originstweaks.firecharged_projecti: [Secondary] fires 3 fireballs in a row. 10 s cooldown, and needs more than 3 drumsticks of hunger.
power.originstweaks.fire_immunity.name: Fire Immunity
power.originstweaks.fire_immunity.descri: Flame cannot touch what is made of flame.
badge.originstweaks.fire_immunity.0: Immune to fire and lava damage, with lava vision, and immune to heat stroke. Heat never builds up in you.
power.originstweaks.blaze_kinship.name: Blaze Kinship
power.originstweaks.blaze_kinship.descri: Blazes recognize you as one of their own and will not attack you. Neither of your fireballs can harm the other.
power.originstweaks.gift_of_the_skies.de: Your wings fold against your back like a promise, and open wide on the wind.
badge.originstweaks.gift_of_the_skies.0: Press [Primary] while gliding to surge in the direction you look, once per second. Costs 100 of 1360 stamina, or 150 in armor of 13 to 19. Your hits deal 50% less damage for 1 s after a surge. Hold Jump while gliding to fly where you look at up to 25 blocks per second, pulling hardest when you look almost straight up. Armor weakens the pull. Costs 10 stamina a second (15 in armor of 13 to 19).
badge.originstweaks.gift_of_the_skies.1: Hold [Secondary] for half a second to fold or spread your wings.
badge.originstweaks.gift_of_the_skies.2: Stamina refills in 15 s while you are not gliding. Armor of 20 or more is too heavy to surge.
badge.originstweaks.gift_of_the_skies.3: Fireworks cannot be used while gliding.
badge.originstweaks.gift_of_the_skies.4: Equip an elytra to show vanilla wings in place of your chosen ones, which enables elytra resource packs and cape patterns.
power.originstweaks.companion_mounting.d: A trusted friend may cling to your back and share the sky.
badge.originstweaks.companion_mounting.0: Sneak so another player can mount you. [Secondary] kicks them off, and you wait 5 s before the next mount.
badge.originstweaks.companion_mounting.2: A crash or a hit from any projectile throws your passenger off.
power.originstweaks.aerial_combatant.des: A strike from the open sky carries the whole weight of the wind behind it.
badge.originstweaks.aerial_combatant.0: 28% chance to land a critical hit while you are off the ground.
origin.originstweaks.enderian.name: Enderian
origin.originstweaks.enderian.descriptio: Born in the long shadow of the Ender Dragon, Enderians step through the world as if it were a doorway. Tall and strange, they are kin to the endermen, but water scalds them and warmth withers them.
power.originstweaks.throw_ender_pearl.de: Whenever you wish, you may toss a pearl and step through space to where it lands.
badge.originstweaks.throw_ender_pearl.0: [Primary] throws a harmless ender pearl and teleports you to it. 1.5 s cooldown, and you cannot suffocate on landing.
power.originstweaks.slender_body.name: Slender Body
power.originstweaks.slender_body.descrip: Your body is long and strange like your kin the endermen, taller, farther reaching, and hard to hit.
badge.originstweaks.slender_body.0: You are 33% larger, about 2.4 blocks tall.
badge.originstweaks.slender_body.1: Reach: 6 blocks to attack and 5 blocks to break or place.
badge.originstweaks.slender_body.2: A projectile that would hit you teleports you away instead, every 2.5 s.
badge.originstweaks.slender_body.3: Bare-handed, you break blocks as if with Silk Touch.
badge.originstweaks.slender_body.4: Your long limbs strike 2 harder and stride 15% faster.
power.originstweaks.hardy_frame.name: Hardy Frame
power.originstweaks.hardy_frame.descript: Your kind endure the barren End on almost nothing, and a little food carries you far.
power.originstweaks.ender_kinship.name: Ender Kinship
power.originstweaks.ender_kinship.descri: Endermen see you as one of their own, so meeting their gaze never provokes them.
badge.originstweaks.ender_kinship.0: Endermen do not become hostile when you look at them.
origin.originstweaks.beastfolk.name: Beastfolk
origin.originstweaks.beastfolk.descripti: Part human, part beast, hardy hunters with a predator's grace and a predator's hunger. Prey flees their scent and skeletons shy from their claws, but stone is a stubborn foe and villagers fear their growl.
power.originstweaks.claw_mode.name: Claws Out
power.originstweaks.claw_mode.descriptio: Draw your claws, and the hunt begins.
badge.originstweaks.claw_mode.0: [Secondary] toggles your claws, which power claw strikes, night vision and longer sprinting leaps.
power.originstweaks.natural_hunter.name: Natural Hunter
power.originstweaks.natural_hunter.descr: Empty hands become claws that can be honed on wood and stone.
badge.originstweaks.natural_hunter.0: With an empty main hand and claws out, your attacks become sweeping claw strikes that reach 1 block farther.
badge.originstweaks.natural_hunter.1: Hone claws by using blocks in order: logs or wool (4 attack), smooth stone, polished granite, andesite or diorite (5), iron block (6), diamond block (7), netherite block (8). Netherite claws cut through armor for extra damage.
badge.originstweaks.natural_hunter.2: Claw strikes knock back less, for faster follow-ups. Repeated swings slowly dull your claws, netherite claws dull faster against armored foes, and dying blunts them further.
power.originstweaks.predators_vigor.name: Predator's Vigor
power.originstweaks.predators_vigor.desc: A hardy hunter shrugs off the elements and strikes with strength, but must feed more often.
badge.originstweaks.predators_vigor.0: Take 70% less freezing and heat damage. You never grow colder or hotter than half the scale.
badge.originstweaks.predators_vigor.1: 21% chance to land a critical hit.
power.originstweaks.predators_appetite.d: A well-fed predator hits harder. The fuller the belly, the deadlier the strike.
badge.originstweaks.predators_appetite.0: 28% chance to land a critical hit above 8 hunger (4 drumsticks), and 42% while saturated.
power.originstweaks.vicious_appearance.d: Your predatory mien sends prey fleeing, and no untamed land beast will bear you as a rider.
badge.originstweaks.vicious_appearance.0: Animals flee you and throw you off. Tamed, undead, aquatic and predator animals are unafraid.
badge.originstweaks.vicious_appearance.1: Skeletons back away from you, as they do from wolves.
power.originstweaks.dexterity.name: Acrobatics
power.originstweaks.dexterity.descriptio: A predator's balance lets you land on your feet and spring from a crouch.
badge.originstweaks.dexterity.0: Hold [Primary] on the ground to charge a leap, then release or jump to spring where you look. Costs a little hunger, with a 4 s cooldown. Falling more than 2 blocks cancels the charge.
power.originstweaks.hunter_physique.name: Hunter's Physique
power.originstweaks.hunter_physique.desc: +2 hearts, but stone mines 50% slower and block reach is 1 shorter.
badge.originstweaks.hunter_physique.0: You mine natural stone and ore blocks 50% slower.
badge.originstweaks.hunter_physique.1: You cannot break sturdy stone such as deepslate, obsidian and blackstone.
badge.originstweaks.hunter_physique.3: Strength, or a pickaxe with Efficiency, lifts the mining penalties.
power.originstweaks.cat_vision.name: Nocturnal
power.originstweaks.cat_vision.descripti: The dark holds no secrets from a hunter's eyes.
badge.originstweaks.cat_vision.0: Night vision while your claws are out.
power.originstweaks.aquatic.name: Aquatic
power.originstweaks.aquatic.description: Your natural spawnpoint is in the ocean, and you receive more damage from impaling.
origin.originstweaks.phantom.name: Phantom
origin.originstweaks.phantom.description: Half human and half phantom, they drift between flesh and spirit. Bound by soul energy, they take a phantom's winged form at will, slip through solid stone and fade from sight inside it, but sunlight bars their magic and gold turns them away.
power.originstweaks.phantomize.name: Phantom Form
power.originstweaks.phantomize.descripti: Shed your flesh and take the form of a phantom that flies on wings.
power.originstweaks.phantom_sunburn.name: Sunburn
power.originstweaks.phantom_sunburn.desc: You catch fire in direct sunlight unless you hold an umbrella.
badge.originstweaks.phantom_sunburn.0: Holding an umbrella in either hand blocks the burn. Helmets do not. You start with an umbrella when you choose this origin.
badge.originstweaks.phantomize.0: Sneak and press or hold [Secondary] to transform into a phantom over half a second, and back again. It lasts until you change back and costs no soul energy.
badge.originstweaks.phantomize.1: In Phantom Form you look like a phantom with a smaller body. Having no arms, you will your tools to act with soul magic: each item use costs 5 soul energy, and below 5 you cannot use items. Each melee hit with something in your main hand costs 3, and below 3 you cannot strike with it at all. Bare-handed hits are free. Hostile mobs cannot target you. A mob you strike hunts you down regardless.
badge.originstweaks.phantomize.2: Phantom Form lets you fly by double-tapping jump, free of cost. You glide toward where you look, keep your momentum and bank into turns like a phantom. Braking sheds speed gradually, and slamming into something at speed hurts.
badge.originstweaks.phantomize.3: Sprinting while flying doubles your flight speed. Keep it up for 1.5 s and you build smoothly over 2 s to an avian's top surge speed.
power.originstweaks.phantom_kinship.name: Phantom Kinship
power.originstweaks.phantom_kinship.desc: The phantoms that gather when you go without sleep know you as kin, and that kinship lends you strength.
badge.originstweaks.phantom_kinship.0: Phantoms deal no damage to you.
badge.originstweaks.phantom_kinship.3: Stored souls feed your strikes: 1.2x damage at 25 soul energy, 1.45x at 50 and 1.7x at 80 or more.
badge.originstweaks.phantom_kinship.4: Hostile mobs are neutral to you until you strike one.
power.originstweaks.phasing.name: Phasing
power.originstweaks.phasing.description: In phasing mode you slip through solid stone, though the densest blocks turn you away.
badge.originstweaks.phasing.0: Hold [Primary] (not sneaking) to enter or leave phasing mode, in either form. It costs 1 soul energy every 2 s, and 1 more per second while inside blocks.
badge.originstweaks.phasing.1: While inside blocks you cannot sprint unless flying in Phantom Form, attack, use items or interact with blocks.
badge.originstweaks.phasing.2: Sneak on the ground to sink down. Flying in Phantom Form, you pass through blocks in every direction at full speed. Obsidian-tough blocks, gold blocks and bells cannot be phased through.
badge.originstweaks.phasing.3: In phasing mode you are translucent while you have any soul energy, and invisible while you have more than a third of your soul energy.
badge.originstweaks.phasing.4: Sunlight bars summoning and ends phasing mode. Holding an umbrella in either hand lets you phase in sunlight.
badge.originstweaks.phasing.5: Phasing mode ends when your soul energy runs out.
power.originstweaks.summon_phantoms.name: Summon Phantoms
power.originstweaks.summon_phantoms.desc: Call kindred phantoms out of the dark to fight at your side.
badge.originstweaks.summon_phantoms.0: Sneak and hold [Primary] to summon two phantoms. Costs 40 soul energy, with a 10 s cooldown. Not usable in sunlight.
power.originstweaks.soulbound.name: Soulbound
power.originstweaks.soulbound.descriptio: A phantom's form is held together by souls, and you fade when they run out.
badge.originstweaks.soulbound.0: Soul energy runs from 0 to 100. Outside phasing mode it refills 1 every 0.5 s, and fully on waking or respawning.
badge.originstweaks.soulbound.1: Kills give 5 energy (weak mobs), 25 (medium) or 50 (strong), and a boss (over 50 max health) fills the bar. A Soul Fire Aspect kill gives 15 more. Within 8 blocks of soul fire you gain 4 per second.
badge.originstweaks.soulbound.2: Like a vampire you feed on the living: each hit on a passive creature or villager siphons 2 energy, and killing one draws 10 more on top of the usual amount. Hits on players siphon only 1.
power.originstweaks.spectral_wail.name: Spectral Wail
power.originstweaks.spectral_wail.descri: Screech like a phantom, and the world answers by showing you every living thing nearby.
badge.originstweaks.spectral_wail.0: Hold [Secondary] (not sneaking) to wail. Every non-sneaking creature within 32 blocks glows for 10 s. 30 s cooldown.
power.originstweaks.aurophobia.name: Aurophobia
power.originstweaks.aurophobia.descripti: Gold has a repellent effect on your kind.
badge.originstweaks.aurophobia.0: You cannot eat golden food, wear golden armor, use golden tools or phase through gold blocks. Held golden tools deal no damage.
badge.originstweaks.aurophobia.1: Foes striking you with a golden tool deal 50% more damage.
origin.originstweaks.shulk.name: Shulk
origin.originstweaks.shulk.description: Kin to the shulkers, with a shell grown like armor over a soft body. They blink away from blows and send homing bullets to lift their foes into the air, though their strength is heavy and their stamina poor.
power.originstweaks.natural_armor.name: Sturdy Skin
power.originstweaks.natural_armor.descri: Even without armor, your shell hardens to turn aside harm.
badge.originstweaks.natural_armor.0: Hold sneak to grow your shell: +1 armor every 2 s, up to +7.
badge.originstweaks.natural_armor.1: A hit of 3 hearts or more cracks it: -2 armor, and no buildup for 30 s.
power.originstweaks.shell_dodge.name: Shell Dodge
power.originstweaks.shell_dodge.descript: When a blow lands, you sometimes vanish in a blink and shrug it off, then need a moment to gather yourself.
badge.originstweaks.shell_dodge.0: A hit from a living attacker has a 30% chance to teleport you a few blocks away and negate the damage. 10 s cooldown.
power.originstweaks.shulker_bullets.name: Shulker Bullets
power.originstweaks.shulker_bullets.desc: Your shell stores homing shulker bullets that lift whatever they strike into the air.
badge.originstweaks.shulker_bullets.0: Press [Secondary] to fire a homing bullet at a creature in view within 24 blocks. It levitates for 10 s.
badge.originstweaks.shulker_bullets.1: A levitating victim cannot open an elytra.
badge.originstweaks.shulker_bullets.2: Your shell holds 15 charge and each bullet costs 2, enough for 7 rapid shots. Charge regrows 1 every 2 s.
power.originstweaks.shulker_kinship.name: Shulker Kinship
power.originstweaks.shulker_kinship.desc: Shulkers recognize you as one of their own and will not fire at you.
power.originstweaks.cold_resistance.name: Tempered Skin
power.originstweaks.cold_resistance.desc: Cold bites at you less than most.
badge.originstweaks.cold_resistance.0: Take 70% less freezing damage and resist chill. Water still chills you fast, but never past half the scale.
badge.originstweaks.heat_sensitivity.0: Take double heat damage and heat up faster.
power.originstweaks.enderian_heat_sensit: Warmth withers you, save in the Warped Forest, where your kin gather and the heat leaves you be.
badge.originstweaks.enderian_heat_sensit: Take double heat damage and heat up faster, except in the Warped Forest.
Water, rain and water cauldrons deal 2 damage every second (1 on Easy). Water Protection reduces it, and an umbrella blocks rain.
power.originstweaks.blazeborn_water_vuln: Water is agony to your flame, and even the rain scalds you.
badge.originstweaks.blazeborn_water_vuln: Contact with water hurts you twice a second. Rain hurts too, unless you hold an umbrella. Water Protection reduces both.
origin.originstweaks.vanilla_elytra.name: Default
origin.originstweaks.vanilla_elytra.desc: Your wings render as a plain elytra.
origin.originstweaks.feathered_wings.des: Your wings render as soft feathered wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.golden_wings.name: Golden Wings
origin.originstweaks.golden_wings.descri: Your wings render as gilded feathered wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.colored_wings.name: Rainbow Wings
origin.originstweaks.colored_wings.descr: Your wings render as vivid rainbow feathered wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.paper_wings.name: Paper Wings
origin.originstweaks.paper_wings.descrip: Your wings render as light paper wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.magic_wings.name: Magic Wings
origin.originstweaks.magic_wings.descrip: Your wings render as shimmering magic wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.flandre_wings.name: Flandre's Wings
origin.originstweaks.flandre_wings.descr: Your wings render as Flandre Scarlet's crystalline magic wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.ikaros_wings.name: Ikaros's Wings
origin.originstweaks.ikaros_wings.descri: Your wings render as Ikaros's rosy synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.nymph_wings.name: Nymph's Wings
origin.originstweaks.nymph_wings.descrip: Your wings render as Nymph's pale azure synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.astraea_wings.name: Astraea's Wings
origin.originstweaks.astraea_wings.descr: Your wings render as Astraea's icy crystal synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.chaos_wings.name: Chaos's Wings
origin.originstweaks.chaos_wings.descrip: Your wings render as Chaos's violet crystal synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.hiyori_wings.name: Hiyori's Wings
origin.originstweaks.hiyori_wings.descri: Your wings render as Hiyori's gilded rose synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.melan_wings.name: Melan's Wings
origin.originstweaks.melan_wings.descrip: Your wings render as Melan's dark crimson synapse wings, a custom texture separate from the vanilla Elytra.
origin.originstweaks.no_render.name: No Wings
origin.originstweaks.no_render.descripti: Disables the rendering of wings, useful for wingless flight or custom Elytra models via mods like Figura.
layer.originstweaks.avian_wings.name: Wings
originstweaks.gui.choose_wings.title: Choose your Wings.
originstweaks.gui.view_wings.title: These are your chosen Wings.
origin.originstweaks.beastfolk_collar.de: You live among the other races and wear a belled collar as a sign of good faith. Knowing how a growl frightens them, you have learned to hold yours back, even in pain.
origin.originstweaks.beastfolk_no_collar: You keep to the wilds and wear no collar. Rugged and feral, you never learned to swallow a growl, and you care little that it frightens the other races.
originstweaks.gui.choose_collar.title: Choose your Collar.
originstweaks.gui.view_collar.title: This is your chosen Collar.
A bushy russet tail, dark at the tip and brightening toward the base.
origin.originstweaks.beastfolk_tail_wolf: A thick grey tail, dark at the tip and brightening toward the base.
originstweaks.gui.choose_tail.title: Choose your Tail.
originstweaks.gui.view_tail.title: This is your chosen Tail.
